description: NaNi₂H₃(SO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaNi₂H₃(SO₅)₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(2), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.02 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and one longer (2.01 Å) S-O bond length. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and one longer (2.01 Å) S-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.52 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ni, one H, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.52 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ni, one H, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ni, one H, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one O atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one O atom.
